storylines: GORD: A blank slate after a seven-nothing loss is either terrifying or motivating. I haven't decided which. CASEY: I'm going with motivating. You get a night like tonight, you don't want to feel it again. And the guys who weren't there tonight — Stevenson, McKinley, Moore — they come back into a lineup that's got something to prove. I like what that does to a room. GORD: Or they come back, we give up five, and I spend another Friday grumbling into a microphone. CASEY: That's Ice & Easy. We'll see you Friday.
